subject.title: [Feature]: Disable image optimization when images are uploaded to Slack

question: Should Slack media delivery honor the existing per-call `forceDocument`/`asDocument` raw-upload contract, add a separate default-off Slack upload-fidelity setting, or keep the optimizing pipeline as the supported behavior?
rationale: Source inspection proves Slack lacks a raw-upload switch, but selecting the user-facing contract affects channel semantics, possible config surface, and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Honor Existing Per-Call Fidelity Knob
options.body: Wire Slack uploads so explicit `forceDocument`/`asDocument` sends disable image optimization while leaving existing default behavior unchanged.

options.title: Add Default-Off Slack Setting
options.body: Add a Slack-owned account/channel setting for raw uploads with docs, tests, and clear override semantics for existing deployments.

options.title: Document Current Optimizing Pipeline
options.body: Keep Slack media on the shared optimizing loader and document that exact-byte transfer is not a Slack delivery guarantee today.

recommendation.title: Honor Existing Per-Call Fidelity Knob
recommendation.body: Wire Slack uploads so explicit `forceDocument`/`asDocument` sends disable image optimization while leaving existing default behavior unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans shared media loading, plugin SDK surface, and channel config compatibility, where this history has the strongest routing signal.
